proc_path.title: Procfs directory
proc_path.description: Absolute path to the Linux procfs mount. Defaults to /proc, prefixed by NETDATA_HOST_PREFIX when set.

collect_fds.title: Collect file descriptors
collect_fds.description: Collect open file types, unique files per group and descriptor-limit utilization. Disabling this reduces directory scans and readlink calls.

collect_pss.title: Collect proportional memory
collect_pss.description: Sample proportional set size and estimate memory usage between samples. Disabling this avoids smaps_rollup reads.

groups.title: Application groups
groups.description: Ordered application rules. The first matching rule wins; unmatched processes use process-tree grouping.

name.title: Group name
name.description: Name shown for processes assigned to this application group.

match.title: Matching rules
match.description: Any rule may match. Within a rule, all populated fields must match.

comm.title: Command name
comm.description: Shared matcher expression for the command name, for example glob:postgres*.

cmdline.title: Command line
cmdline.description: Shared matcher expression for the command line, for example regexp:gunicorn|uvicorn.
